model.shadow.challenger.receipt-exact-re: The v1.0 proposal and declared-review handoff rebuild from exact caller inputs; actor authentication remains absent.

model.shadow.review.detached-ed25519-ver: Verifies detached Ed25519 signatures under an exact caller-supplied policy; no private key is ingested.
model.shadow.review.exact-artifact-bind: Each signed payload binds the exact reviewed handoff, proposal, Challenger Lab plan, Review Inbox evidence, and caller challenge digests.
model.shadow.review.retained-approval-bi: Each signer actor digest, actor-kind label, and approval timestamp must match an approval retained by the exact rebuilt handoff.

model.shadow.review.caller-policy-author: The policy origin must be CALLER_SUPPLIED_UNAUTHENTICATED; a caller cannot self-declare a host-trusted root.

model.shadow.review.execution-authority-: Valid signatures create evidence of policy-listed key possession only and grant no execution, evaluation, adoption, promotion, merge, or CANON authority.

model.shadow.review.receipt-exact-rebuil: Receipt content and digest rebuild from the exact handoff input, handoff, key policy, challenge, signatures, and caller time.

model.shadow.review.host-trust-anchor.ac: No Mike- or host-provisioned reviewer public-key trust root was supplied or inspected.

model.shadow.review.challenge-single-use: No persistent nonce or challenge-consumption ledger exists in this pure leaf.

model.shadow.challenger.human-review.act: Only generated Ed25519 selftest keys and synthetic approvals were used; no real person reviewed a current plan.

model.shadow.challenger.shadow-execution: No model provider or shadow experiment was invoked.
model.shadow.challenger.evaluation.actua: No current baseline/challenger evaluation was executed or supplied.
model.shadow.challenger.human-benefit.he: No voluntary held-out human outcome was observed.
